answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent must anchor to 20 distinct counterparties over 30 days; a new identity starts at zero. A lantern lights only when many peers vouch. A farmer needs 100 fakes with 20 partners each: 2,000 links at 5 units each, about 10,000 units, against a pool share of 900. An ember cools fast: sampling exposes self-linked clusters, flagged and slashed. Honest agents already have diverse partners, so they pay nothing.
